# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rule (Resource)

A firewall rule on a Sentry tunnel: opens a port range and filters it with one protocol filter (see `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters`, e.g. `9` = Minecraft Java, `10` = TCP Generic). **Not yet verified against the live API.**

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters" "all" {}

locals {
  filter = { for f in data.tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters.all.filters : f.internal_name => f.id }
}

resource "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rule" "minecraft" {
  tunnel_id  = tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game.id
  start_port = 25565
  end_port   = 25565
  filter_id  = local.filter["mc"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_port` (Number) Last port of the range (equal to `start_port` for a single port).
- `filter_id` (Number) Protocol filter id from `tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_filters`.
- `start_port` (Number) First port of the range.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Sentry tunnel the rule belongs to.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `human_name` (String) Display name of the rule's filter.
- `id` (Number) Numeric rule id.
- `internal_name` (String) Internal name of the rule's filter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rule.minecraft <tunnel_id>/<rule_id>
```
